title: 第23章  沧澜秘境第24章  亚特兰蒂斯
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
夜离殇的目光从手臂上的御兽印记上移开，看向身旁的龙疏寒，道：“龙阿姨，我下周一要参加学院的沧澜秘境，估计要在秘境中待几天的时间，所以那几天的训练可能要耽误了。”
“沧澜秘境吗？”
龙疏寒微微颔首：“刚好在黑市，在黑市中看看有没有什么好东西，或是你在秘境中能用得上的东西，给你买一些，以备不时之需。”
龙疏寒说着，牵起夜离殇的手，带着她往黑市中的深处走去。
两人在黑市中转了一圈，买了各种各样的药剂和培育材料后，才离开黑市，往所居住的地方走去。
有些昏暗的街道上。
夜离殇看着自己背着的背包，嘴角始终带着淡淡的笑意。
黑市是个好东西。
这次在黑市中的收获，让她非常的满意，各种各样的药剂，还有市面上买不到的稀有培育材料，都足够让她使用很久了。
回到家后。
夜离殇放下背包，唤出云绒狐，给它喂了几块御兽口粮后，夜离殇就往浴室中走去。
……
时间飞逝。
五天后。
沧澜学院。
湛蓝色的秘境入口前，夜离殇抱着云绒狐站在队伍的前列，一条青色的小蛇则是盘绕在她的手腕上，时不时的用小脑袋蹭着她的手腕，带起一丝丝的冰凉感觉。
青蛇是夜离殇的第二只御兽幽鳞青蛇。
幽鳞青蛇是在两天前孵化出来的，如今有着二级的实力，而云绒狐在这几天的训练中，实力已经从三级提升到了四级，稳稳站在新生的前列。
“在进入秘境之前，我要叮嘱你们几句。”
“沧澜秘境，开启的时间为五天，期间采用积分制进行排名，击杀秘境中的妖兽，可以获得积分，击杀的妖兽实力越强，获得的积分也就越多。”

“在进入秘境之前，我会给你们每人发一个手环，这个手环不仅是积分器，也是保护你们安全的东西，遇到危险的时候，捏碎手环或是将手环打碎，就能从秘境中退出来了。”
“最后一点就是，在秘境中要以自身安全为主，不要逞强，也不要冒险，一切量力而行，优先保证自己的安全。”
凌沧海在说话的同时，将一个个手环分发给面前的学生们。
夜离殇看着拿到的手环，只见手环的样式类似于一个手表，上面有一块小屏幕，屏幕上有着一个0的数字。
将手环戴在手上后，夜离殇稍微活动了一下身体，做着进入秘境前的准备。
等所有人拿到手环后，众人就在凌沧海的吩咐下，依次走进湛蓝色的秘境中。
走入湛蓝色的秘境中，夜离殇感觉眼前一花，什么都看不清，随即就是一阵天旋地转外加失重的感觉。
天旋地转的感觉消失，夜离殇感觉自己好像是落在了冰凉但却柔软的床上。
一阵空灵，带着几分缥缈感的歌声传入她的耳中。
歌声没有歌词，只有简单的音节哼唱，但旋律中却蕴含着无尽的孤寂和悲伤。
视线逐渐恢复。
夜离殇下意识地往歌声来源的方向看去，继而身体一僵，瞳孔骤缩，呼吸几乎停滞。
只见她身下的根本就不是什么柔软的床榻，而是一条白皙如玉的手臂，而夜离殇此时则是坐在一位体型巨大，外貌类似于人类女性的妖兽手臂上。
这只妖兽有着银白色的长发，白皙的肌肤如白玉般细腻，耳朵呈现为鱼鳍状，眼眸紧闭，缥缈的歌声从其口中传出，似乎是在沉睡中哼唱。
咕嘟～
content_en:
Ye Lishang moved his eyes away from the beast control mark on his arm, looked at Long Shuhan beside him, and said: "Aunt Long, I will participate in the Canglan Secret Realm of the academy next Monday. I will probably stay in the secret realm for a few days, so the training for those days may be delayed."
"Canglan Secret Realm?"
Long Shuhan nodded slightly: "I happened to be in the black market. Let's see if there are any good things in the black market, or things that you can use in the secret realm. I'll buy some for you in case you need it."
Long Shuhan said, taking Ye Lishang's hand and leading her deeper into the black market.
The two wandered around the black market and bought various potions and cultivation materials before leaving the black market and walking towards the place where they lived.
On some dark streets.
Ye Lishang looked at the backpack he was carrying, with a faint smile on his lips.
The black market is a good thing.
She was very satisfied with her harvest in the black market this time. The various potions and rare cultivation materials that were not available on the market were enough for her to use for a long time.
After returning home.
Ye Li Shang put down his backpack, called out the Cloud Velvet Fox, and after feeding it a few pieces of beast-control rations, Ye Li Shang walked to the bathroom.
…
Time flies.
Five days later.
Canglan College.
In front of the entrance to the azure secret realm, Ye Lishang stood at the front of the team holding Yun Ronghu, while a small green snake coiled around her wrist, rubbing its little head against her wrist from time to time, bringing out a slight cold feeling.
Green Snake is Ye Lishang's second beast, the Green Snake with Dark Scales.
The Dark Scale Green Snake was hatched two days ago and now has a level two strength. In the past few days of training, the Yunrong Fox's strength has been improved from level three to level four, firmly standing at the forefront of the new students.
"Before entering the secret realm, I want to give you a few words of advice."
"Canglan Secret Realm will be open for five days. During this period, a points system will be used to rank. You can get points by killing monsters in the secret realm. The stronger the monsters you kill, the more points you will get."
"Before entering the secret realm, I will give each of you a bracelet. This bracelet is not only an integrator, but also something to protect your safety. When you encounter danger, you can crush the bracelet or break it to pieces and you can exit from the secret realm."
"The last point is to put your own safety first in the secret realm. Don't show off or take risks. Do everything within your ability and prioritize your own safety."
While Ling Canghai was speaking, he distributed bracelets to the students in front of him.
Ye Lishang looked at the bracelet he got and saw that the style of the bracelet was similar to a watch, with a small screen on it and a number 0 on the screen.
After putting the bracelet on his hand, Ye Lishang moved his body a little to prepare for entering the secret realm.
After everyone got the bracelets, everyone walked into the blue secret realm one by one under Ling Canghai's instructions.
Walking into the azure secret realm, Ye Lishang felt that his eyes were blurred and he couldn't see anything clearly, and then he felt like the world was spinning and he felt weightless.
The spinning feeling disappeared, and Ye Lishang felt as if he had landed on a cold but soft bed.
A burst of ethereal, somewhat ethereal singing came into her ears.
The song has no lyrics, just humming simple syllables, but the melody contains endless loneliness and sadness.
Vision gradually returned.
Ye Lishang subconsciously looked in the direction of the source of the singing, then his body stiffened, his pupils shrank suddenly, and his breathing almost stopped.
What was underneath her was not a soft bed at all, but an arm as white as jade, and Ye Lishang was sitting on the arm of a huge monster beast that looked similar to a human woman.
This monster has long silver-white hair, fair skin as delicate as white jade, its ears are like fins, its eyes are closed tightly, and a ethereal singing voice comes from its mouth, which seems to be meditating.Humming in your sleep.
Gudu~
